# The switches, 1 = the default: never at a loss, wait for free workers, take turns, close other businesses for
# a plan's workers, other businesses in planned locations, grant a plan's charter and rights; and the game's own
# automation that closes buildings, 1 = on.
pp_tplan_loss_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_loss_ok }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_staff_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_staff_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_order_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_order_best }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_close_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_system_automated = closebuildings }
		value = 1
	}
}

# One payback step from scope:pp_tplan_cur (the index it starts from, any = the last step + 1): longer (past the
# last step: any payback) and shorter (from any: the last step; never below the first).
pp_tplan_pb_next_up = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	add = 1
	max = 13
}
pp_tplan_pb_next_down = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	subtract = 1
	min = 1
}

# ---- Plan options (country scope; town_plans.py "Plan options", town_plan_options.py; the window reads them) ----
# Lowest production efficiency in %: every goods plan's (pp_tplan_effv_all, a step of EFF_STEPS) and each goods
# plan's own (pp_tplan_effv_<plan>: a step, 14 = none; unset = the all-plans line). _pct = the line shown
# (0 while none), _set = 1 while a line holds (a line of 0 % is a line), _own = 1 while the plan has its own.
pp_tplan_eff_pct_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_all }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 1.5 } value = -10 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 2.5 } value = -5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 3.5 } value = 0 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 4.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 5.5 } value = 10 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 6.5 } value = 15 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 7.5 } value = 20 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 8.5 } value = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 9.5 } value = 30 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 10.5 } value = 40 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 11.5 } value = 50 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 12.5 } value = 60 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_all < 13.5 } value = 75 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_eff_set_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_all }
		value = 1
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 4.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 5.5 } value = 10 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 6.5 } value = 15 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 7.5 } value = 20 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 8.5 } value = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 9.5 } value = 30 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 10.5 } value = 40 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 11.5 } value = 50 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 12.5 } value = 60 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 13.5 } value = 75 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_eff_set_tin = {
	value = pp_tplan_eff_set_all
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_tin }
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 13.5 } value = 1 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_eff_own_tin = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_tin }
		value = 1
	}
}

		limit = { pp_tplan_eff_set_saltpeter > 0.5 }
		value = pp_tplan_eff_pct_saltpeter
		add = 1000
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { pp_tplan_eff_set_copper > 0.5 }

		add = 1000
	}
}

# The switches, 1 = on (the default): raise a settlement for its plan, the Food plan's staple food makers and
# kitchens, the Trade plan's Marketplace line, Port Authority and market centre buildings.
pp_tplan_raise_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_raise_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_food_farms_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_farms_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_food_kitchens_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_kitchens_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_trade_market_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_market_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_trade_port_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_port_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_trade_centre_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_centre_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
# The Food plan's Taverns: 0 never, 1 while the province's store is short (the default), 2 always.
pp_tplan_food_taverns_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns }
		value = var:pp_tplan_food_taverns
		subtract = 1
	}
}
# The Food plan builds only while the province's store lasts less than this many months (0 = always).
pp_tplan_food_store_months = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_store }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 1.5 } value = 3 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 2.5 } value = 6 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 3.5 } value = 9 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 4.5 } value = 12 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 5.5 } value = 18 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_store < 6.5 } value = 24 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_food_store_set = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_store }
		value = 1
	}
}
# The Trade plan builds only where at least this share (%) of the country's merchant capacity in the market is in
# use (0 = always).
pp_tplan_trade_use_pct = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_use }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_trade_use < 1.5 } value = 10 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_trade_use < 2.5 } value = 25 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_trade_use < 3.5 } value = 50 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_trade_use < 4.5 } value = 75 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_trade_use < 5.5 } value = 90 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_trade_use_set = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_use }
		value = 1
	}
}

# One step of the options' steppers from scope:pp_tplan_cur. The lowest production efficiency and the trade
# capacity in use have "none" below their first step (0); the store limit has "always" past its last step.
pp_tplan_eff_next_up = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	add = 1
	max = 13
}
pp_tplan_eff_next_down = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
pp_tplan_trade_use_next_up = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	add = 1
	max = 5
}
pp_tplan_trade_use_next_down = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
pp_tplan_food_store_next_up = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	add = 1
	max = 7
}
pp_tplan_food_store_next_down = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	subtract = 1
	min = 1
}

# Location scope (in the pass): the location's lasting production efficiency in % + 1000 (plan option "lowest
# production efficiency"): its local_production_efficiency and its owner's global_production_efficiency, the
# production efficiency every building here gets, without the short-lived modifiers (town_plans.EFF_SHORT_LIVED:
# the event modifiers the game adds for at most five years, and raised levies). A building's own terms
# (establishment, the province's raw materials, the bonus per level) are left out.
pp_tplan_eff_here = {
	value = modifier:local_production_efficiency
	owner ?= { add = modifier:global_production_efficiency }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = raised_levies } add = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = proper_administrative_ledgers_modifier } subtract = 0.01 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = location_innovative_tooling_techniques_modifier } subtract = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = local_quality_standards_modifier } subtract = 0.05 }
	province ?= {
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pious_wealth_modifier } subtract = 0.1 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = province_innovative_tooling_techniques_modifier } subtract = 0.05 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = poor_tool_quality_modifier } add = 0.05 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = local_artisans_retired_modifier } add = 0.2 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = new_tooling_techniques_modifier } subtract = 0.1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = trade_and_production_cutbacks } add = 0.05 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = calvinist_work_ethic } subtract = 0.025 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = free_trade_of_goods } add = 0.05 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = influential_guild_members } subtract = 0.025 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = guilds_cooperating } subtract = 0.025 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = uinal_yaxkin_modifier } subtract = 0.025 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = quinquatria_modifier } subtract = 0.025 }
	}
	multiply = 100
	add = 1000
}

# Location scope (in the pass: scope:pp_cplan_country): the share (%) of the country's merchant capacity in the
# location's market that is in use (plan option "trade capacity in use"); 100 where it has none there yet (the
# plan's buildings give the first).
pp_tplan_trade_use_here = {
	value = 100
	market ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { "merchant_capacity(scope:pp_cplan_country)" > 0 }
			value = "used_merchant_capacity(scope:pp_cplan_country)"
			divide = "merchant_capacity(scope:pp_cplan_country)"
			multiply = 100
		}
	}
}
